statement.p: Compute the derivative of the given function. f(t) = \sqrt[4]{t}(\csc t - 6 e^{0.9 t}).

static.solution:
Solution:
Use the Product Rule. \begin{array}{rcl} f'(t) \amp =\amp \displaystyle \sqrt[4]{t} \frac{d}{dx}[ \csc t - 6 e^{0.9 t} ] + \frac{d}{dx}[\sqrt[4]{t}] (\csc t - 6 e^{0.9 t}) \\ \amp \amp \\ \amp =\amp \displaystyle \sqrt[4]{t} (-\csc t \cot t - 5.4 e^{0.9 t}) + \frac{1}{4}t^{-3/4} (\csc t - 6 e^{0.9 t}) \end{array}
